proof_body:
by
  intro l q a hl hq h1 h2
  haveI := Fact.mk hl
  haveI := Fact.mk hq
  have e1 : (a : ZMod q) ^ l = 1 := by
    have := (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd (a ^ l - 1) q).2 h1
    push_cast at this
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 this
  have e2 : (a : ZMod q) ≠ 1 := fun e => h2 ((ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ q).1 (by push_cast; rw [e]; simp))
  have e3 : (a : ZMod q) ≠ 0 := by
    intro e
    rw [e, zero_pow hl.ne_zero] at e1
    exact zero_ne_one e1
  have o : orderOf (a : ZMod q) = l := orderOf_eq_prime e1 e2
  have d : l ∣ q - 1 := o ▸ ZMod.orderOf_dvd_card_sub_one e3
  exact ((Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hq.one_le).2 d).symm
target_source: ∀ (l q : ℕ) (a : ℤ), Nat.Prime l → Nat.Prime q → (q : ℤ) ∣ a ^ l - 1 → ¬ (q : ℤ) ∣ a - 1 → q ≡ 1 [MOD l]
